info.title: Swagger
info.description:
This documentation allows for testing the API features.
To start, register for an API key.Once registration is complete, take your API key and enter it in the top right input box of this page.
Select endpoint name to open the implementation notes. Click the Try it out! button to execute the current endpoint.Once you are comfortable with this, try the filter parameters.

get.description: Data can be filtered using optional query parameters. See the paramters section. Cameras Documentation

parameters.name: map-bounds-sw
parameters.description:
Filter Parameter:
South west map bounds as two double values separated by comma (longitude,latitude)
Requires filter [map-bounds-ne] to complete the bounding box.

e.g. map-bounds-sw=41.01106167071922,-82.36851259765625

parameters.name: map-bounds-ne
parameters.description:
Filter Parameter:
North east map bounds as two double values separated by comma (longitude,latitude)
Requires filter [map-bounds-sw] to complete the bounding box.

e.g. map-bounds-ne=41.01106167071922,-82.36851259765625

parameters.name: region
parameters.description:
Filter Parameter:
Name of the region you want to pull results for
Can send multiple regions comma separated

Valid values are
akron, central-ohio, cincinnati, cleveland, columbus, dayton, ne-ohio, nw-ohio, se-ohio, sw-ohio, toledo

e.g. region=ne-ohio
e.g. region=cleveland,akron

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description:
Filter Parameter:
Returns results within the radius of a lat long point.
Values are latitude,longitude,miles from center point.

e.g. radius=41.01106167071922,-82.36851259765625,3

parameters.name: page-size
parameters.description:
Filter Parameter:
Sets maximum number records to return from the API request.
If filter [page-size] not sent and [page-all] not sent then default page-size is 500.

e.g. page-size=50

parameters.name: page
parameters.description:
Filter Parameter:
Skips a set of results based on page size and returns the next set of results from the API request.
Skip [page-size] * [page] and returns [page-size] of results.
If filter [page-size] not sent and [page-all] not sent then default page-size is 500.

e.g. page=5

parameters.name: page-all
parameters.description:
Filter Parameter:
Ignores paging parameters and returns all data from a result set.
This does not discard other filters such as region and map bounds.
Valid values are
true, yes, y, 1

e.g. page-all=true

parameters.name: include-future
parameters.description:
Filter Parameter:
Allows you to view current construction and planned construction up to future date
Date should be sent as yyyy-MM-dd

e.g. include-future=2026-11-09

parameters.name: future-only
parameters.description:
Filter Parameter:
Allows you to view planned construction starting tomorrow up to the future date
Date should be sent as yyyy-MM-dd

e.g. future-only=2026-11-09

parameters.name: exclude-work-zone
parameters.description:
Filter Parameter:
Allows you to exclude work zone details from your construction response.
Reduces the response payload if this data is not required.

Filter Parameter:
Filters out signs by sign-type
Can send multiple signs-types comma separated

Valid values are
(dms or message-board), (ddms or travel-time), (sign-queue or slow-traffic), (vsl or variable-speed-limit)

e.g. sign-type=message-board
e.g. sign-type=dms,ddms
